about_the_game:
Palmora: Free Sample

Palmora: Free Sample invites you to experience the heart of Palmora’s production and trading world with this exclusive demo edition. Start from scratch, build your first workshop, gather materials, and step into a relaxing life simulation where every step forward is yours to shape.

Earn your first Palin by collecting trash from the streets and recycling it. Use your income to set up a basic workshop, unlock a limited set of production licenses, and craft and sell various products. You’ll also get to explore the city using over five different vehicles and enjoy Palmora’s dynamic atmosphere through a real-time day-night cycle.

This sample version is designed to let you explore the core gameplay of Palmora—production, packaging, trading, and personal progression. While expanded maps, interior decorations, advanced shopping areas, wholesale markets, and storage management are features reserved for the full version, Palmora: Free Sample still offers a satisfying glimpse into the full life sim experience.

Ready to begin your journey? Palmora is waiting!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280 or equivalent (DirectX 11 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
